content: Estimating subword translation probabilities from aligned word vectors requires an additional processing step since the provided vectors from fastText are not at subword level. We use the following approximation to obtain subword vectors: the vector $_s$ of subword $s$ is the weighted average of all the aligned word vectors $_{w_i}$ that have $s$ as an subword
